identity.title: [v0.92.1][tools][csdlc-v3] Fix terminal authority reporting and issue-create parity

values.task_boundary: Implement the #721 v3 parity and reporting defects only; record adjacent v3 defects as backlog issues.
deliverables: authenticated issue-create reconciliation and receipt of the assigned issue number
truthful terminal authority reporting tests and implementation
operator documentation showing the real v3 issue-create path
backlog issue records for adjacent defects
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: csdlc-v3 finish --observe-github reports operational authority truthfully after cutover when it persists terminal state.
AC-2: Pre-cutover denial remains fail-closed and non-mutating.
AC-3: v3 GitHub issue-create supports title, body, labels, assignees, and milestone with structured argv, credential-child injection, operation marker, reconciliation, and idempotent replay.
AC-4: The issue-create receipt records GitHub's assigned issue number.
AC-5: Documentation distinguishes local issue-state preparation from real GitHub issue creation and shows a non-fake operational command.
AC-6: Adjacent v3 defects discovered during execution are recorded as backlog issues.
dependencies: #505 v3 cutover authority state on main
#725 native v3 authority after v2 removal follow-up
non_goals: Do not implement the simplified gh-style front-end command; that is #724.
Do not fix proof/shadow/install validation failures; that is #723.
Do not replace v2 authority dependencies after cutover; that is #725.
